name: Vacation Employees
query:
SELECT
    la.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:150",
    la.employee_name AS "Employee Name:Data:200",
    emp.department AS "Department:Data:150",
    la.company AS "Company:Link/Company:180",
    la.leave_type AS "Leave Type:Data:150",
    la.name AS "Application ID:Link/Leave Application Form:180",
    la.from_date AS "From Date:Date:110",
    la.to_date AS "To Date:Date:110",
    la.no_of_days AS "Total Days:Float:100"
  
FROM
    `tabLeave Application Form` la
LEFT JOIN
    `tabEmployee` emp
    ON emp.name = la.employee
WHERE
    la.docstatus = 1
    
    AND CURDATE() BETWEEN la.from_date AND la.to_date
    AND la.company = %(company)s
ORDER BY
    la.from_date DESC
